sources.title: Federal Republic of Somalia: Ordinary Passport service
sources.publisher: Immigration and Citizenship Agency, Federal Republic of Somalia
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Federal Government service page identifies the Immigration and Citizenship Agency as responsible for the ordinary passport and defines its international-travel purpose.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The primary purpose of an ordinary passport is to serve as a form of identification and travel document for citizens when travelling internationally.

sources.title: Somali Civil Aviation Authority: Somali travel documents
sources.officialityEvidence: The Federal Somali Civil Aviation Authority notice identifies the Federal Government's passport types and says documents not issued by the Somali Government and without its national emblem are invalid for travel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ordinary passports (P prefix) ... Any passport or travel document NOT issued by the Somali Government ... shall not be allowed for travel.

sources.title: Cuba Travel: Regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's official tourism portal gives tourist-entry rules, identifies the visa-exempt Chinese-citizen exception and directs other visitors to the eVisaCuba electronic tourist-visa process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The tourist visa is mandatory to enter Cuba if you do not have Cuban residency.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal identifies SNEDAI as the only visa-application website officially recognised and approved by the State of Côte d'Ivoire, and limits the route to valid ordinary passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement à l'aéroport d'Abidjan.

policies.title: Somali ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Somali visitor and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available from anywhere except the United States.
conditions: Use a valid Federal Somali ordinary passport (P prefix), not a Somaliland or other non-Federal Somali document. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; a Somali ordinary-passport holder without Cuban residency must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel; Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate. The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the valid Federal Somali ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Somali ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's official valid-ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: The route applies to a valid Federal Somali ordinary passport (P prefix), not a Somaliland or other non-Federal Somali document. Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.
At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the valid Federal Somali ordinary passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

conflicts.explanation: The official valid-ordinary-passport process requires approved online pre-enrolment before travel and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport. The Federal Somalia sources establish that the eligible document is the ordinary Federal Somali passport, not a Somaliland document.
